backgrounds.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: finished raster background for a playable top-down Bomberman-like pirate party game, not a mockup. Square composition. Premium cheerful hand-painted game illustration with softly sculpted rounded forms, crisp dark-navy details, controlled rich colors and soft ambient shadows, polished cartoon mobile-game art, NOT flat vector clip art. The interface is maritime blue, so the illustration should belong to this world while having convincing material colors. Camera strictly overhead, orthographic, no perspective tilt. Crucial gameplay mask: the central rectangle spanning x=9.375% to 90.625% and y=10.714% to 89.286% must be COMPLETELY EMPTY WALKABLE FLOOR, subtle low-contrast texture only. No objects, walls, boxes, characters, grass tufts or shadows interrupt that central rectangle; runtime game pieces will be overlaid there. All detailed set dressing belongs in the outer border and corners, leaving a crisp recognizable rectangular playable area. Fill the whole square image, no frame outside the scene, no transparency. No UI, no letters, no writing, no grid lines, no baked-in players, bombs, crates or pillar layout, no watermarks or logos. Theme: the powder hold of a playful pirate ship. A cool desaturated blue-gray painted deck for the empty central floor, surrounded ONLY at the perimeter by rounded blue timber ribs, steel portholes with hints of sea outside, sturdy support beams, a few coiled ropes and carefully placed barrel silhouettes. Warm amber pools of lantern light on the outer border, deep cobalt crevices, creamy white highlights. Rich cohesive environment, not a decorative ring of repeated identical icons. Do not add hanging lanterns themselves: a separate animated lantern will be composited later.

Top-left sprite center (25%,25%), top-right center (75%,25%), bottom-left center (25%,75%), bottom-right center (75%,75%). Each sprite entirely inside its quarter, with 8% empty padding on each edge of that quarter; nothing crosses quarter boundaries. No visible grid, no labels, no text, no logos, no watermark, no background scene, no checkerboard baked into the image. Premium playful hand-painted mobile-game art, softly sculpted rounded forms, crisp navy contours and rich realistic material colors, consistent subtle soft shadows immediately under each object. Top-down orthographic viewpoint for the top two gameplay objects, clear silhouette and readable at 32 pixels, no perspective vanishing point. Bottom two sprites are decorative objects animated separately by the application. All four sprites must be genuinely cut out with alpha transparency, not placed on white rectangles. TOP LEFT: one solid indestructible square ship's steel support block, cobalt-blue chunky metal with pale rim, sturdy rivets, distinguishable from wood. TOP RIGHT: one destructible compact closed powder barrel made of warm honey-brown wood with two dark navy metal bands, seen from directly above as a squarish rounded barrel top; no face, no fuse, no fire. BOTTOM LEFT: one beautiful hanging ship's lantern with navy frame, glowing amber glass, small curved suspension loop at top, full body visible. BOTTOM RIGHT: a second smaller handsome glowing maritime lantern with dark navy frame and warm amber light. Theme is a pirate ship's powder hold, warm light, cool blue steel.
